432701.name: Barrage
432701.description: Fires rockets, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

432702.name: Salvo
432702.description: Fires a barrage of assault rifle shots, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

432703.name: Large Caliber Rifle
432703.description: Fires a large caliber rifle, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

432705.name: Laser Strafe
432705.description: Shoots laser beams from all tentacles, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

432707.name: Rapture Absorption
432707.description:
Absorbs the Raptures nearby.
Uses Laser Strafe upon successful absorption.
Absorbed Raptures will disappear.

432708.name: Launch Raptures
432708.description:
Summons Raptures.
Summoned Raptures are invulnerable and can only be attacked when they are absorbed by Fingers.
